Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
O Allah, quench us with rain
And spread upon us Your mercy with Your abundant rain

Arabic text: مِنَ السَّحَابِ الْمُنْسَاقِ لِنَبَاتِ أَرْضِكَ الْمُونِقِ فِيْ جَمِيْعِ الْآفَاقِ
Translation: From the flowing clouds for the flourishing plants of Your earth in all regions
And bestow upon Your servants the ripening of fruits
And revive Your lands with blooming flowers
And let Your noble, recording angels witness
A beneficial watering from You, continuous in its abundance
Vast in its flow, heavy, swift, and immediate

Arabic text: تُحْيِيْ بِهِ مَا قَدْ مَاتَ، وَتَرُدُّ بِهِ مَا قَدْ فَاتَ
Translation: By which You revive what has died, and restore what has been lost
And bring forth what is to come
And increase through it our provisions
Clouds that are layered, pleasant, wholesome, covering
Resounding with thunder, its rain not delayed
Nor its lightning without rain

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ اسْقِنَا غَيْثًا مُغِيثًا مَرِيعًا مُمْرِعًا عَرِيضًا
Translation: O Allah, quench us with rain that brings relief, fertility, abundance, and vastness

Arabic text: وَاسِعًا غَزِيرًا تَرُدُّ بِهِ النَّهِيضَ وَتَجْبُرُ بِهِ الْمَهِيضَ
Translation: Extensive and plentiful, by which You restore the weak and mend what is broken

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ اسْقِنَا سَقْيًا تُسِيلُ مِنْهُ الظِّرَابَ
Translation: O Allah, give us rain that makes the hills flow
And fills the water reservoirs
And causes the rivers to burst forth
And makes the trees grow

Arabic text: وَتُرْخِصُ بِهِ الْأَسْعَارَ فِيْ جَمِيْعِ الْأَمْصَارِ
Translation: And lowers the prices in all cities
And revives the animals and all creation
And completes for us the good provisions
And grows for us the crops
And makes the udders flow with milk
And increases our strength upon strength

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ لَا تَجْعَلْ ظِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا سَمُومًا
Translation: O Allah, do not make its shade upon us poisonous
And do not make its cold upon us destructive
And do not make its downpour upon us a punishment
And do not make its water bitter for us

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
And grant us from the blessings of the heavens and the earth
Indeed, You have power over all things
